title: Evidence maturity for trustworthy machine learning in geological CO2 storage: WP9.8-R1 data and reproducibility archive
description: Synchronized evidence matrix, screening and adjudication records, decision profiles, field-anchor matrix, figure and table traceability data, and deterministic scripts supporting a decision-centered review of trustworthy machine learning for geological CO2 storage. The locked primary corpus contains 70 full-text-verified records and the main quantitative universe contains 57 claim-eligible records. Copyrighted article PDFs and private review workbooks are excluded.
